description: The network operating systems and appliances cvENGINE names from what a scan already stored, with no version (cveFeed.identities): an identity reading (vsrc:nmap, outcome hidden, never a technology), searched by tech:, component: and os:, a lead for the version source reads (edge_builds' FortiOS, PAN-OS and NetScaler reads) and for correlation. 'systems': the operating system an nmap OS guess or one of its runners-up names (IpAddress.os_guess, fingerprint.os_matches; matched case-insensitively against 'guess'), with the CPE its CVE records use. 'certificates': a certificate default to the appliance (Port.tls as nmap's ssl-cert prints it: 'commonName=FG101FTK19000000/organizationName=Fortinet/...'); every pattern in 'all' must match its field. Each entry names its source. A certificate a person issued names nothing, and a vendor without a default certificate pattern from a citable source is read from the OS guess only.
